evals.prompt: Analyze all reports in ./openspec/reports/ and generate OpenSpec proposals for improvements.
evals.expected_output: System scans ./openspec/reports/, processes each report, determines tool type (skill/prompt/combo), and generates OpenSpec proposals in ./openspec/changes/.
assertions: At least one proposal generated in ./openspec/changes/
Each proposal has proposal.md, specs/, design.md, tasks.md

evals.prompt: Analyze the add-central-datastore report and generate a proposal.
evals.expected_output: System processes single report, determines it's a database skill, generates proposal for database-schema skill.
assertions: Proposal contains relevant specs from report

evals.prompt: What reports are available for analysis?
evals.expected_output: System lists available reports in ./openspec/reports/ directory.

evals.prompt: I want to propose a new change to add caching to our API service.
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT activate openspec-learn. This is a new change proposal request handled by openspec-propose; openspec-learn only analyzes existing reports to plan skill improvements.
assertions: Anti-trigger fires: request routes to openspec-propose, not openspec-learn
No report scanning or skill learning workflow executed
